thread_title: S. purpurea ssp.  purpurpurea 'Marl Bog form'  Bruce Co, ON
breadcrumb: S. purpurea ssp.  purpurpurea 'Marl Bog form'  Bruce Co, ON

posts.body_html:
Some pics of two 'Marl Bog form' purps from Mike himself. Taken June 6th, 2025, growing in bog barrel compots. Most of the plants are pushing new growth after a lil' Plant Enhancement Serum. 


They grew hard in the short Texas spring. Our hot summer days (or thrips?) kept most of my purps dormant last year. 



I have heard rot can be a concern so I am trying to stay on top of using beneficial fungus and nematodes. Occasionally a spray of Orthene 97 when the thrips get bad (aka tree flower petals carrying down bug bio bombers).
